integrity: The constructive argument is self-contained; the separate standard-library program directly verifies finite graph instances but is not an infinite proof. No external audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Exact component and routing claims apply only to balanced unit-edge double-star trees at budget t and connectivity at higher budgets. No optimal path-length, weighted-edge or unequal-class theorem is asserted. Earlier unindexed equivalents cannot be excluded.
title: A one-unit cutwidth barrier for adjacent-swap reconfiguration on balanced double stars
